About

I build secure, connected digital health systems that bring research into practice.

I’m a PhD student and researcher with the HUMADEX research group at the University of Maribor, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (UM FERI). My work connects AI, healthcare data interoperability, IoT and cybersecurity through European research projects.

With a master’s degree in Telecommunications, I develop microservices and cloud infrastructure, work with HL7 FHIR and secure data flows, and help evaluate digital tools in clinical settings. My interests include AI-supported care, conversational systems and resilient healthcare platforms.

SMILE & AI4HOPE Digital mental health & dementia care

  • Expand FHIR server architecture and automate healthcare data flows.
  • Implement Keycloak authentication, VPN and firewall controls; develop and maintain Python and Java microservices, VMs and containers.

HosmartAI Clinical interoperability & social robotics

  • Developed an HL7 FHIR patient-resource database, REST services and the supporting infrastructure at UM FERI.
  • Helped integrate and evaluate the Pepper humanoid robot with patients, doctors and nurses at University Medical Centre Maribor.

PALANTIR Cybersecurity & threat mitigation

  • Developed an incident-management component using finite state machines and Java’s Spring State Machine framework.
  • Integrated REST communication with Apache Camel and event streaming with Kafka; tested AI-based threat-detection microservices.

PERSIST Patient sensing & quality of life

Contributed to a multimodal sensing network for patient-reported data and quality-of-life assessment. Managed physical servers, VMs and containers; developed Python, Flask and Spring Boot services with MQTT, REST, Apache Camel and Kafka.

Teaching & collaboration

Taught Android development and mentored student projects over two semesters. Contributed to research publications, project deliverables, technical reports, presentations and project reviews.
